@angelaaa Exactly! That's one of our key advantages. Unlike general-purpose face search engines, Face2Social is built specifically for social media discovery. We focus on finding matching faces across social platforms and connecting them directly to public profiles, with names and links — not just pages containing similar photos.

Of course, matches still need to be verified, but we make that process much faster and easier.
